page.overview:
What is Tirtouga?

Tirtouga is a reptilian Pokémon that resembles the Archelon, a group of extinct sea turtles. Its body is mainly deep blue, and it bears a black/blue shell on its back. Its skin is a lighter blue, with its face covered in a marking that is the same color as its shell. It has more of these markings in the middle of its fins.

Though slow and clumsy on land, they nevertheless could beach themselves onto shores in order to capture unsuspecting prey. Indeed, some studies suggest that a sizable portion of their meals came from terrestrial prey. Tirtouga are thought to have gone extinct because they was unable to compete with similar chelonians; although their competitors were slower, they also required less food to survive and reproduce.

Tirtouga evolves into Carracosta starting at level 37.

Tirtouga, alongside Carracosta appear in A Restoration Confrontation! Part 1 and A Restoration Confrontation! Part 2.
